finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 13 user-facing.

Two are breaking. The `v1` export route was deleted. Five modules stopped re-exporting internal error types. Both were labelled `refactor`, so they will surprise people.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

| Cut | Why |
|---|---|
| ~90 dep bumps | All patch or minor |
| perf commits | No visible behavior change |
| tests, CI, docs | Not shipped |

Two things to check. I dated it `2026-08-29`, and the log ends `2026-06-17`. Also confirm the `v1` route really had no users.
